$comment: The commit-message checker is a byte copy of kleidos-dev/agents at the commit below. The kit's reusable-commit-check.yml runs this copy, taken from the kit commit a repository records, so every repository's CI checks with these bytes; the commit-msg hook in each repository runs that repository's own copy of the same file. Never edit it here: change it in kleidos-dev/agents, copy it again, and update the commit and the digest (quality/tests/test_commit_check_copy.py).
